description: Original hopcroft_karp mod.rs with bounded correspondence models.
state: Left adjacency rows and right count. L+R<=1,000,000 and E<=1,000,000. Return one optional right mate per left.
cost: O((L+R+E)*sqrt(L+R+1)) time including isolated-array scans; O(L+R) auxiliary space. Each phase advances row cursors at most E times. Checked edge sums and short-circuited vertex subtraction precede allocation. Depth bounded by cap; allocation failure untyped.
forward: Reject combined vertex cap, counted edge cap, then first invalid neighbor. BFS from all free left vertices obtains shortest alternating depth. Explicit DFS stacks and shared cursors find shortest paths and prune dead left states. Flip each path; repeat until no free right is reachable.
inverse: U is declared inputs/errors crossed with outputs. C=U minus forward relation R includes wrong first errors, infeasible witnesses and wrong optima/canonical fields. Exact specification, partial Rust correspondence only. Mate arrays are reciprocal partial injections supported by input edges. Each augmentation increases cardinality by one. Matched-left transitions increase distance; only shortest free-right endpoints finish paths. No augmenting path remains on return.

Pre(y)={x in domain | R(x,y)} preserves every compatible input. Traversal history is omitted, graph redundancy creates multiple antecedents, and errors have whole first-failure fibers. No unique inverse or reconstruction executor claimed.
limitations: Finite evidence, not a general proof; allocation failures unmodeled.
Partial syntax excludes macro expansion and semantic resolution.
